title: Interaction-Gated Time-Frequency Learning for Parameter-Efficient PPG-Based Heart Rate Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost and non-invasive heart rate (HR) monitoring but remains sensitive to waveform distortion, physiological variability, and measurement interference. Temporal waveform characteristics and frequency-domain periodicity provide complementary information for HR estimation; however, effectively exploring and integrating these representations within a compact model remains challenging. This paper proposes TF-IG, a parameter-efficient interaction-gated time-frequency learning framework for PPG-based HR estimation. TF-IG employs a dual-branch architecture in which a temporal branch captures pulse morphology via dilated depthwise-separable convolutions, while a frequency branch extracts cardiac periodicity information from bounded log-spectrogram representations. translated_title: 面向参数高效的基于光电容积脉搏波（PPG）心率估计的交互门控时频学习
translated_abstract: 光电容积脉搏波描记法（PPG）能够实现低成本、无创的心率（HR）监测，但其对波形失真、生理变异性以及测量干扰仍然较为敏感。时域波形特征与频域周期性信息为心率估计提供了互补信息；然而，如何在一个紧凑的模型中有效探索并整合这些表征仍然是一个挑战。本文提出了TF-IG，一个用于基于PPG心率估计的参数高效交互门控时频学习框架。TF-IG采用双分支架构：时域分支通过膨胀深度可分离卷积捕获脉搏形态信息，频域分支则从有界对数频谱图表示中提取心脏周期性信息。为了融合这两个域的信息，我们引入了一个交互门控融合模块，该模块显式地建模特征之间的一致性与差异性，同时还……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出TF-IG框架，通过参数高效的时域-频域双分支架构以及显式建模特征一致性与差异性的交互门控融合模块，实现了基于PPG的准确心率估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TF-IG, a parameter-efficient interaction-gated time-frequency learning framework that combines a dual-branch temporal and frequency architecture with an interaction-gated fusion module explicitly modeling feature agreement and discrepancy for accurate PPG-based heart rate estimation.
